-- Access UI -------------------------------------------------------------
local function New(class,props)
    local o=Instance.new(class)
    for k,v in pairs(props or {}) do
        if k~="Parent" then o[k]=v end
    end
    if props and props.Parent then o.Parent=props.Parent end
    return o
end

local function Round(p,r)
    return New("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r or 10),Parent=p})
end

local function Stroke(p,c,t,thickness)
    return New("UIStroke",{
        Color=c,
        Transparency=t or .72,
        Thickness=thickness or 1,
        ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
        Parent=p
    })
end

local function parentGui()
    if type(gethui)=="function" then
        local ok,r=pcall(gethui)
        if ok and r then return r end
    end
    local ok,r=pcall(function() return CoreGui end)
    if ok and r then return r end
    return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local parent=parentGui()
local old
pcall(function() old=parent:FindFirstChild("SerenityAccessV2") end)
if old then old:Destroy() end

local gui=New("ScreenGui",{
    Name="SerenityAccessV2",
    ResetOnSpawn=false,
    IgnoreGuiInset=true,
    ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
    DisplayOrder=999999,
    Parent=parent
})

local scale=New("UIScale",{Scale=1,Parent=main})
local function resize()
    local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local v=cam.ViewportSize
    scale.Scale=math.min(1,(v.X-24)/470,(v.Y-24)/318)
end
resize()
if workspace.CurrentCamera then
    workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(resize)
end

local status=New("TextLabel",{
    Name="Status",
    BackgroundTransparency=1,
    Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,101),
    Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,16),
    Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
    Text="Get your key from a provider, then unlock Serenity.",
    TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(130,143,156),
    TextSize=8,
    TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    Parent=content
})

local function setStatus(text,good)
    status.Text=tostring(text or "")
    status.TextColor3=good==true and Color3.fromRGB(72,224,177)
        or good==false and Color3.fromRGB(235,105,120)
        or Color3.fromRGB(130,143,156)
end

local function providerButton(text,x,w,accent,callback)
    local b=New("TextButton",{
        AutoButtonColor=false,
        BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(25,31,38),
        BackgroundTransparency=.10,
        BorderSizePixel=0,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,124),
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,34),
        Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        Text=text,
        TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(210,217,225),
        TextSize=9,
        Parent=content
    })
    Round(b,8)
    Stroke(b,accent,.55,1)

    New("Frame",{
        BackgroundColor3=accent,
        BorderSizePixel=0,
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,8),
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(2,18),
        Parent=b
    })

    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        b.BackgroundTransparency=.02
        b.TextColor3=accent
    end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        b.BackgroundTransparency=.10
        b.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(210,217,225)
    end)
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return b
end

local totalWidth=434
local gap=8
local providerWidth=math.floor((totalWidth-gap*2)/3)

providerButton("LINKVERTISE",0,providerWidth,Color3.fromRGB(54,207,235),function()
    local u=R(ID_LV)
    if copyText(u) then setStatus("Linkvertise link copied.",true)
    else setStatus("Clipboard access is unavailable.",false) end
    u=nil
end)

providerButton("LOOTLABS",providerWidth+gap,providerWidth,Color3.fromRGB(157,138,255),function()
    local u=R(ID_LL)
    if copyText(u) then setStatus("LootLabs link copied.",true)
    else setStatus("Clipboard access is unavailable.",false) end
    u=nil
end)

providerButton("DISCORD",(providerWidth+gap)*2,providerWidth,Color3.fromRGB(72,224,177),function()
    local u=R(ID_DC)
    if copyText(u) then setStatus("Discord invite copied.",true)
    else setStatus("Clipboard access is unavailable.",false) end
    u=nil
end)

local verify=New("TextButton",{
    Name="Unlock",
    AutoButtonColor=false,
    BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(38,194,173),
    BackgroundTransparency=.04,
    BorderSizePixel=0,
    Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,170),
    Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40),

    Text="UNLOCK SERENITY",
    TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(7,18,19),
    TextSize=10,
    Parent=content
})
Round(verify,9)

New("TextLabel",{
    BackgroundTransparency=1,
    Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,214),
    Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,18),
    Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
    Text=fsReady()
        and "Successful verification is saved locally — you won't need the key again."
        or "This executor can't save files, so access will last for this session.",
    TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(101,113,125),
    TextSize=7,
    TextWrapped=true,
    TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    Parent=content
})

do
    local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local dragging=false
    local dragStart
    local startPos
    local dragInput

    top.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObj)
        if inputObj.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or inputObj.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging=true
            dragStart=inputObj.Position
            startPos=main.Position
            inputObj.Changed:Connect(function()
                if inputObj.UserInputState==Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging=false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    top.InputChanged:Connect(function(inputObj)
        if inputObj.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or inputObj.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput=inputObj
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inputObj)
        if dragging and inputObj==dragInput and dragStart and startPos then
            local delta=inputObj.Position-dragStart
            main.Position=UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale,startPos.X.Offset+delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale,startPos.Y.Offset+delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)
end

local busy=false
verify.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if busy then return end
    local entered=trim(input.Text)
    if entered=="" then
        setStatus("Enter your key first.",false)
        return
    end

    busy=true
    verify.Text="VERIFYING..."
    setStatus("Checking Serenity access...",nil)

    task.spawn(function()
        local keyUrl=R(ID_KEY)
        local ok,remote=pcall(function()
            return game:HttpGet(keyUrl,false)
        end)
        if not ok then
            ok,remote=pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet(keyUrl,true)
            end)
        end
        if not ok then
            ok,remote=pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet(keyUrl)
            end)
        end
        keyUrl=nil
        remote=ok and trim(remote) or nil

        if remote and #remote>=2 then
            local first=ss(remote,1,1)
            local last=ss(remote,#remote,#remote)
            if (first=='"' and last=='"') or (first=="'" and last=="'") then
                remote=trim(ss(remote,2,#remote-1))
            end
        end
        local remoteLower=remote and string.lower(remote) or ""
        local remoteUsable=type(remote)=="string"
            and remote~=""
            and #remote<=128
            and not string.find(remoteLower,"<html",1,true)
            and not string.find(remoteLower,"<!doctype",1,true)

        local embeddedOk=(H(entered)==((2100000000+2027360581)%4294967291))
        local valid=(remoteUsable and secureEq(entered,remote)) or embeddedOk
        remote=nil

        if not valid then
            busy=false
            verify.Text="UNLOCK SERENITY"
            if ok and not remoteUsable then
                setStatus("Key server returned an invalid response. Check the key or try again.",false)
            else
                setStatus("Invalid Serenity key.",false)
            end
            return
        end

        local saved,proof=saveReceipt(entered)
        proof=proof or proofFor(LP.UserId)
        applyCompat(entered,proof)
        setStatus(
            saved and "Access verified — lifetime access saved."
                or "Access verified — session unlocked.",
            true
        )
        verify.Text="ACCESS VERIFIED"

        task.wait(.55)
        if gui then gui:Destroy() end
        launch(entered,proof)
    end)
end)

return nil
